hero.description: Full-stack developer focused on building production-ready web products with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and MongoDB. I design and ship end-to-end features — from API architecture and auth flows to polished, responsive user interfaces.

about.title: A developer who ships
about.whoDesc: Full-stack developer based in District 7, HCMC. I enjoy transforming business requirements into clean, maintainable products — from database design and API logic to the final user experience.
about.whatDesc: I build modern web applications with React / Next.js, Node.js / NestJS, REST APIs, authentication, RBAC, and MongoDB / PostgreSQL. I care about code quality, maintainability, and shipping features users actually rely on.
about.driveDesc: I’m motivated by solving real business problems with simple, scalable systems. I value clean architecture, thoughtful UX, and delivering features that are fast, secure, and reliable.
about.availabilityTitle: Open to full-time and freelance opportunities
about.availabilityDesc: I help teams build modern web products, internal tools, admin dashboards, and MVPs with a strong focus on clean architecture, user experience, and production reliability.
about.help1Desc: Responsive React / Next.js interfaces with clean UX and strong design consistency.
about.help2Desc: REST APIs, business logic, database integration, auth flows, and scalable server-side architecture.
about.help3Desc: Role-based access, validation, environment protection, and dependable production-ready workflows.
about.help4Desc: Rapid product validation, admin dashboards, operational systems, and conversion-focused web apps.
